note: METHOD: IMSLP's composer pages (dates, nationality) and the text of all 422 candidate pages (first performance, performers) were read through api.php; one background script then queried MusicBrainz (artist match, works with recordings), Deezer (album and artist search) and Apple's composerTerm song search for all 96 composers; hits were opened through Deezer and Apple track lists, SFCV and Friction Quartet pages, a NACUSAsf programme PDF and 4 web searches. The shared MusicBrainz limit blocked the script for about 25 minutes, so the last 27 composers were finished Deezer and Apple first; MusicBrainz failed for Wright and Van der Stadt (their 'none found' rests on Deezer and Apple). RESULT: 9 works kept from 3 composers. Verotta (6; San Francisco, a former UCSF biomathematics professor) has no recording, but each kept work was performed by professional ensembles in series (Friction Quartet, Cecilia Ensemble, Haruka Fujii Trio at C4NM, NACUSA SF, Episcopal Church of the Incarnation), shown on the pages in `sources`; his other 26 pages are skipped, mostly 'not checked (budget)': Bronze Chasm 1-2, String Quartets 3, 4, 5, 6, 8 (a Circadian Quartet concert 'Vita Oscura' may be No. 8), 9, Piano Trios 1-3, In Flight, Alpha, Ascending, Despite It, Point Taken, Incandescent (listed on the NACUSA programme of 8 June 2019, version unclear) and others; a second pass could add several. Zwaag (2) is recorded on a self-released album (℗ Wim Zwaag) with named professional players, kept at medium confidence; Torre (1) is on Urtex. OWNER'S CALLS: (1) Own-label streaming albums without credited performers were not counted: Ugoletti (label ECCD: String Quartets 1, 2, 7, 16; he also has discs by Ichos Percussion, Giampaolo Stuani and Ferdinando Nazzaro), Toub (his own label: Two Sets, I-IV-V-I, Five Notes for Christina Fong, Apophenia, Dharmachakramudra), Zak (Apple 'Agape': Quartets 1 and 2), Thiede ('Premier Quatuor, Op. 53'). Add them if such recordings are accepted. (2) 30 composers are not proposed for exclusion because they show some professional record (Violette: Innova, Composers Concordance, ACA; Wallach: CDs and a work written for the Jade String Trio; Wallace; Vermeersch; Zagny; Tariverdiev; Tăutu; Suk ...) but none of their candidate pages is recorded; they are skipped as 'not performed or recorded (composer triage)'. (3) 63 composers are proposed for exclusion: self-uploads with computer or no audio and no recording, publisher or professional performance seen. 'None found' is weak for common names (Wright, Young, Thomas, Watson, Wolfe, Zhou, Yiu, Wilkes, Wilhoit, Wiecielkowski). (4) Tell es-Sakan is entered with two percussionists, as performed, although IMSLP lists one percussion line. Kato's and Frewer's pages are their own arrangements and recordings.
